There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Best of all, students often travel on a small budget.
Sam is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Little by little, things began to change. For example, a gleam of light appeared beneath the door.

The train station looked quieter than usual that evening. The night market has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, the boat moves slowly.

Sam has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. Sam keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. Sam thanked Eva for the honest advice. Shakespeare wrote famous plays like Romeo and Juliet.
Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
